settings.subheading: Hands-on courses in sustainable manufacturing for schools, alternative education providers, and rehabilitation settings

settings.text: Through the Bamboo Mobility Project CIC, we deliver accredited educational programmes that combine hands-on making with employability skills. Our courses are designed for schools, alternative education providers, and rehabilitation settings.

Our award-winning programme where incarcerated parents build bamboo balance bikes for their children.

• High completion rates • 26% confidence uplift • OCN Level 2 qualification • Employer interview opportunities

"A genuinely impactful initiative." — James Timpson, UK Prisons Minister

settings.button_label: Learn more about Build to Bond

settings.text:
STEM education meets Design Technology. Students learn sustainable manufacturing, engineering principles, and hands-on craftsmanship while building real bamboo bicycles.

Suitable for Key Stage 3 & 4, GCSE & A-Level DT, Alternative provision, NEET programmes.
